Function countNonDecreasingSubarrays(nums,k):
result=0,cnt=0,dq=deque, right=len(nums)-1
for left in reversed(range(len(nums))):
  while dq and nums[dq[-1]] < nums[left]:
      l = dq.pop()
      r = dq[-1]-1 if dq else right
      cnt += (r-l+1)*(nums[left]-nums[l])
  dq.append(left)
  while cnt > k:
      cnt -= nums[dq[0]] - nums[right]
      if dq[0] == right:
          dq.popleft()
      right -= 1
  result += right-left+1
return result
